summary: Columbia Financial, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Q2 2026 financial results (net income $14.5M, EPS $0.14) and declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.05 per share payable August 26, 2026 to holders of record August 12, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings announcement with a standard dividend declaration, not a special-situation event. No M&A, strategic review, tender offer, or other extraordinary corporate action is noted. The dividend is a regular quarterly payment, and the financial results are ordinary operating disclosures. Thus, the filing does not qualify as a special situation.
